line: At night under a desk lamp, a pen plotter draws Mount Qomolangma from real elevation data with four pens, and writes its height last.
line_cn: 深夜台灯下，一台笔式绘图仪用四支笔按真实高程画出珠穆朗玛峰，最后一笔写下它的高度。

camera.move: Macro on the nib, paper fibre in focus
camera.serves: a first line; a last stroke; a value being written
a map filling in; a chart building; a pattern spreading
relief; depth; a reveal of scale
a route; a timeline; a process step by step

camera.move: Locked three-quarter on a panel, slight creep
camera.serves: a comparison; a verdict; a legend

camera.expresses: a change of subject or voice
camera.serves: a new layer; a new data series; the answer's colour

camera.move: Pull-back from the sheet to the desk and room
camera.serves: an ending; a reveal of the whole document

transitions: Cuts happen on beats or on a pen drop.
labels: Roles: single-line sans for figures and Latin labels (2.5–10 mm on the sheet; 40–50 mm for a hero number); hairline CJK labels 3–5 mm; a hatched serif for the sheet title. All OFL, subset to the characters used; letters are baked into stroke data, the page loads no font.
Labels live on the sheet: next to what they name, one language per line (Chinese line, then English line, then the value), never in screen space.
Weight by retracing: titles and key values drawn two or three times with a 0.2–0.3 mm offset.
Legibility: anything to be read must reach ≥ 30 px cap height at 1080p when the camera holds on it; small legend text may stay unread.
motion: 30 fps, no stepping; the pen eases into and out of every move; the carriage never teleports inside a shot.

Jump-cut time-lapse: inside a stretch the pen moves at real speed; between stretches machine time jumps forward, on the beat. The camera keeps moving through the jumps; only the machine jumps. Space the jumps closer as the work grows.
Lines appear only under the nib; labels appear stroke by stroke; nothing fades in.
What never moves: the sheet (taped down), the rack, the room.

native_moves.name: Contours growing outward
native_moves.does: Plot terrain levels from the top down, each level nearest-neighbour ordered, with a jump per beat; the shape grows from the centre.
native_moves.fits: a city's growth rings; a heat map spreading from a source; a population density surface.

native_moves.name: The sheet stands up
native_moves.does: In a low shot, lift the drawn lines to their true value (height, time, quantity) and let them settle back; the ink stays on the paper.
native_moves.fits: a surface chart of rainfall; a sound spectrogram; a stock price landscape.

native_moves.name: Hatching as tone
native_moves.does: A light pen hatches only where a value crosses a threshold (shade, risk, loss), two angles for darker.
native_moves.fits: flood-risk zones; areas lost to fire; the shadow side of any terrain.

native_moves.name: The path in the accent ink
native_moves.does: A long-lens follow of one line across a quiet base map, a mark at each stop.
native_moves.fits: a migration route; a delivery round; a river's course.

native_moves.name: The enlarged scale
native_moves.does: A callout from a point on a chart to a zoomed axis where values that differ by 0.1 % can be told apart.
native_moves.fits: successive measurements of a constant; three bids within a cent; record times.

native_moves.name: The pen change as punctuation
native_moves.does: The answer arrives in a new colour after an on-screen or off-screen trip to the rack.
native_moves.fits: the verdict after evidence; the corrected figure after the old one; today's value after history.

native_moves.name: The hero number in single line
native_moves.fits: a total; a date; a record.

score.note: one instrument per pen; the machine is the rhythm
